findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking around dish machine to be broken and damaged. Ensure countertop around dish machine is adhered to the wall with caulking to avoid accumulation of food debris and bacteria. Surfaces need to be smooth and easily cleanable to promote effective sanitizing.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 
Observed the wall behind the garbage grinder at the dish area to have chipped paint and a caulk seal that is no longer intact. The caulk seal that remains has soil growing in it. Seal wall with durable washable paint and seal the counter to the wall. Also the seal on the hand sink is absent. seal hand sink to the wall with caulk seal.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed deli turkey rounds date marked 5-1-22 to be in the walk in cooler. Today is 5-11-22. This is more than the 7 day use allowed under this section of the code. Turkey rounds were discarded in the garbage. Suggested freezing if need to keep over 7 day limit. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed that the facility does not have an irreversible registering temperature indicator for the mechanical ware washing operation. Provide maximum registering thermometer to check functionality of the dish machine. Check machine before each use. 

4-302.13: (A) In manual WAREWASHING operations, a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and SANITIZING temperatures. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed shelves in the walk in cooler  and top shelf of two door snack cooler to be soiled with debris. Clean the shelves and maintain them free of accumulated debris/clean.

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the floor of the dry storage area to be soiled at the legs of the shelving units and between the legs of the shelving units and the wall. Clean and maintain clean. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: Observed no maximum registering thermometer available to check the dish machine temperature. Ensure a maximum registering thermometer or temperature indicating test strips. Some test strips were provided during the inspection to correct the violation. 
A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed two spoons and an ice scoop which are cracked or in disrepair. Repair or replace as soon as possible. They are going to check their back stock to see if they have replacements. If not they will order. 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleansable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: The prep sinks in the prep table top both have an accumulation of slime mold in the corners and one around the drain. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.citation_text:
750.530 - Employee's personal drink in a large thermal mug was observed on a prep table in the food service area. Drink was removed from the area.

Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. Employee's may drink from a closed beverage container if the container is handled to prevent contamination of the employee's hands, the container, and exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, single service articles and linens.
Have a designated storage area for personal drinks, and properly wash hands after taking breaks for drinks and prior to returning to food service.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) bottom inside candy bar cooler (debris);
B) bottom inside warmer (splash);  and
C) lower shelves of prep tables (splash/dust).

Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1220 - Floor under candy cooler was soiled with dust accumulation.

Floor under the steam table and single basin prep sink has been cleaned, but more detail cleaning is needed along the walls and in the corner. An accumulation of food and general debris was present. 

Clean the floors in the aforementioned areas, and maintain floors throughout clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1210 - Ceiling had water damage along the front edge of the hood where a leak was observed during the previous inspection. All necessary repairs were made to equipment on the roof, and the area is no longer experiencing a leak. Make proper repairs to the ceiling.

Walls and ceilings must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.160 - Worker was observed adjusting clothing and touching face with gloved hands and returning to handling clean dishes without changing gloves. Proper glove use was discussed and gloves were changed. 


Gloves are intended for only one task and must be changed when they become soiled, torn, or an interruption in task occurs.
**Keep in mind gloves are meant to protect food and clean equipment from the germs on your hands. Gloves must be changed and accompanied by handwashing any time gloved hands touch your person in any way (i.e. adjust clothing, scratch face, cough into hand, etc.) or when gloved hands tough any surface that is not considered clean (i.e. handles of coolers, food boxes/outer surfaces of packaging, dirty dishes, etc.).**

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
70.830g - Quat test kit was available for checking Multi-Quat sanitizer. However, spray bottle labeled sanitizer had a bleach solution in it (200ppm chlorine). Employee was advised that chlorine test strips would also be needed in addition to quat strips if bleach solutions are sometimes used for sanitizing surfaces. Obtain chlorine test strips, and maintain a supply of both types of test strips at the facility.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of each chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solutions. in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled:
A) (R) ceiling inside microwave (dried food splash);   and
B) ice machine - baffle inside (mold along bottom right corner).

Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 & 1100 - A) (R) Opening was observed on the underside of ice machine where condensate was dripping onto the floor. Provide a proper drain line on the underside of the ice machine.

Drain lines from equipment shall not discharge waste water in such a manner as will permit the flooding of floors or the flowing of water across working or walking areas or into difficult-to-clean areas, or otherwise create a nuisance.

B) Leak was observed at the seal of a line connecting to the dish machine on the lower left side. Water was observed dripping along the bottom of the dish machine on to the floor. Re-seal the area to eliminate the leaking water.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text:
750.1210 & 1220 - A) Walls in walkin cooler were soiled with what appeared to be buildup of dust and/or mold on/around the door. Clean the walls and ceiling in the walkin cooler as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

B) Leak was observed in the ceiling along the front edge of hood. Water was dripping onto the floor beside the oven (area was not going to be used for food prep today). Staff noted the maintenance worker was on the roof trying to determine the original spot where water was coming through (believed to be caused by hail damage that occurred during a storm earlier in this morning).

Walls and ceilings must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Employee wiped hands with wet wiping cloth from sanitizer bucket. Employee washed hands at the handsink upon request of inspector.
Employee did not use paper towels as a barrier to shut off manual faucet at the end of handwashing process. Proper handwashing technique was discussed.
Always use paper towels to dry, and then use paper towels to shut off the faucet at the final step of handwashing process.
Employee was later observed doing proper handwashing technique, and also properly washed hands upon exiting the restroom and prior to returning to food prep.

Employees shall properly wash their hands any time their hands may have become contaminated and prior to handling food or clean equipment.
Refrain from wiping hands on wet wiping cloths and common towels. Use of common towels is prohibited.
**Educational handouts on handwashing and glove use were provided**

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Chlorine test kit was available, but facility uses Multi-Quat sanitizer. Obtain and use quat test strips for sanitizer used at the facility.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Damp wiping cloth was used to wipe down prep table. Wiping cloth was placed on the ledge of the dirty dish counter. Quat solution was prepared, and wiping cloth was placed in the solution.

Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution between uses to inhibit the growth of microorganisms. Change the solution every 2 to 4 hours or more often if solution and wiping cloths become heavily soiled.
